correctness.rationale: Cyclic rotation partitions q³-q nonconstant triples into length-three necklaces, at most one codeword per necklace, and an ordered-letter cut attains the upper bound. Every maximum code is exactly C(B)={(a,b,c):B_ab=1,B_bc=0} for a zero/one context partition. Equality forbids monochromatic directed 3-cycles and forces tied letter pairs to form a matching, uniform orientations from pairs to outside letters, and a transitive tournament on blocks. Every such block arrangement achieves equality. Every context bit is recoverable from prefix/suffix sets except the diagonal of a singleton initial block; removing that binary duplication yields Pell recurrence T_q=2T_(q-1)+T_(q-2), total q!(P_(q+1)-P_q). Independent enumeration of all binary q×q matrices through q=4 verified numbers of maximal matrices 10,72,696 and distinct codes 6,42,408; these finite tests corroborate the infinite structural proof.

final_claim: For labeled q-letter alphabets, q>=2, length-three codes forbidding ONLY a two-symbol prefix–suffix coincidence have maximum cardinality (q³-q)/3 and exactly q!(P_{q+1}-P_q) distinct labeled maximizing codes; all extremizers have an ordered singleton/pair-block context-matrix description with one invisible first singleton diagonal bit.
limitations: Only length-three words forbidding overlap length exactly two, not cross-bifix-free or arbitrary lengths.
Finite enumeration through q=4 does not replace the structural all-q proof.
